altrincham.snapshot: Altrincham sits in Trafford, where full-fibre crews and a busy commercial cabling trade keep the network growing. Build contractors run fleets of engineers on trade accounts and buy their workwear through procurement, while ex-BT sole traders, CCTV fitters and one-van broadband installers order direct online with no account. We run both routes side by side so the whole trade, from the big crews to the lone installer, gets branded kit.
altrincham.s1_head: Kitting the field engineers of Trafford
s1loc: Altrincham is in the middle of the Greater Manchester full-fibre push. Openreach has engineers running fibre out through the town and the wider borough, and the alternative networks are building hard alongside - brsk has been rolling gigabit full fibre out across Greater Manchester from Stockport and the surrounding towns, with CityFibre and the mobile operators upgrading on top. Crews work through Altrincham town centre, Hale, Bowdon, Timperley and Broadheath, threading new fibre through streets, joint boxes and customer premises as the build pushes out from the exchange into the residential edges.

Alongside the residential rollout sits a solid commercial scene. Altrincham Business Park and the Hanover Industrial Estate off George Richards Way, plus the older Broadheath industrial belt toward Trafford Park, give structured-cabling and CCTV firms a steady run of work wiring offices, units and multi-site businesses in Cat5e, Cat6 and fibre. Local installers handle business WiFi, hosted phone systems and monitored CCTV across the borough, while Trafford College and the retail core around Stamford Quarter add schools, shops and offices to the mix of premises being cabled.
